title: Lakebase Terraform resources are generally available
body: As of Databricks Terraform provider v1.145.0, these Lakebase resources are generally available: `databricks_postgres_project`, `databricks_postgres_branch`, `databricks_postgres_endpoint`, `databricks_postgres_database`, `databricks_postgres_role`, `databricks_postgres_catalog`, `databricks_postgres_synced_table`, and `databricks_postgres_snapshot_schedule`. Release status varies by resource. To check the status of any Lakebase resource, see the release stage badge on its page in the [Terraform Registry](https://registry.terraform.io/providers/databricks/databricks/latest/docs). See [Get started with Terraform for Lakebase](/aws/en/oltp/projects/automate-with-terraform).
